entities.name: Mayer Amschel Rothschild
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: German-Jewish banker (1744-1812) who founded the Rothschild banking dynasty, establishing an international financial network that financed governments, wars, and infrastructure across Europe. His five sons created branches in Frankfurt, London, Paris, Vienna, and Naples, making the Rothschilds the most powerful banking family of the 19th century.
